import_overrides.comment: partial = resolved but a stub, a forwarder, or not verified to work; none = not provided

d3d12x.comment: Track each interface from slot zero through its baseline or highest recorded slot, whichever is larger. Each slot counts once across GXDK editions. Done = forwarded or implemented. Partial = incomplete behavior or a verified diagnostic binding. Observed unmapped records retail calls with unknown behavior, including calls covered by a diagnostic. See docs/COMPATIBILITY.md for middleware call sites.
